summary: The customer, who lost their job, said they could not afford the $1,200 monthly payment and proposed paying $700 now and $700 next month. The agent said a supervisor must approve the split and will follow up by Friday, and offered a temporary 30‑day hold on late fees while noting a permanent grace extension requires underwriting review. The customer accepted the proposed temporary hold and agreed to await the follow‑up.
